dict.string: HOS uses the microphone only when you start a voice recording, to measure local voice levels. Audio stays on your iPhone and is never uploaded.
HOS opens the camera only when you choose to capture a photo. Nothing is recorded automatically.
HOS reads your location while you use the app to enrich your local health context. Location is not tracked in the background.
HOS uses motion and fitness data to detect sitting, walking, running, and vehicle states for your local activity context.
HOS reads selected Apple Health metrics such as steps, heart rate, and energy to build your local health context. HOS does not diagnose or treat any condition.
HOS does not write health data in this MVP. This description is required by HealthKit capability setup.
